newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin says 1997 budget key parliamentary task.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin says 1997 budget key parliamentary task.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin said on Thursday he hoped for cooperation with both houses of the Russian parliament and said approval of the 1997 budget was parliament's top task.

"The country is waiting for parliament to pass important laws, above all the budget for next year," Yeltsin said in a radio address. "We hope for constructive work with the Federation Council and the State Duma."
The State Duma lower house of parliament, where Yeltsin's opponents have a majority, is due to start full hearings on the 1997 budget next Friday.
The spending plans envisage a deficit of 3.30 percent of gross domestic product compared with a budgeted shortfall of 3.85 percent this year.
